framework.title: OWASP Mobile Application Security Verification Standard

mappings.rationale: Backend/data ownership includes sensitive storage, retention, deletion, and access evidence.
Protected operations require trusted-boundary authorization and explicit interface contracts.
Integration contracts define bounded transport, identity, failure, and sensitive-field behavior.
Client engineering requires platform-appropriate permissions, state, and semantic controls.
Dependency policy requires maintained, pinned, reviewed, and removable components.
Legal/privacy routing preserves data-purpose, minimization, disclosure, and specialist-review questions.
